title: Outline a discussion of any depth

blocks.text: The forum's outline view lists every post of a discussion with how deep it sits in the thread. One discussion has turned into a game: each new post answers the previous one, and it is now hundreds of thousands of posts deep. Opening its outline kills the request with a `StackOverflowError`.

Write `lines(...)` in `src/main/java/practice/Outline.java`. Its comment gives the format and the order. When you're done, the outline of any discussion comes out in reading order with the right depth on every line, however deep it goes, even on a thread with a small stack. About ten lines in total.

cases.says: a short chain of replies is outlined, one line per post with its depth
a chain 200,000 posts deep is outlined on a thread with a 512 KB stack
a post's replies come out oldest first, each followed by everything under it
each post's depth is the number of posts above it, whatever came before it in the outline

origin.section: Each Call Holds a Stack Frame Until It Returns, So Recursion Depth Is Limited by the Stack

concepts: Data whose depth users control is walked with an explicit stack on the heap, which must carry what the recursion's frames held (the depth) and push children so they come off in order.
